capability类的事件方法。装备入口与真实LivingUpdate→InventoryEquipment.update→onEquipmentTick已接通。首枚ItemRingOfDispersion（含子类）是getRing返回值，不会在第一枚坏/冷却时继续找下一枚。 原生GetCollisionBoxesEvent回调在global gathering=false时进入try/finally防重入，向cap传event AABB和原可变collision list。每次cap调用先清isPhasing、将两种obstructionDistance设MAX；canPhase要求damage<maxDamage、非spectator、潜行、无此item cooldown。合格才清原列表并经自有Helper重建；没有写entity.noClip。 自有重建Helper保留非同乘实体碰撞ALL；方块先以blockAabb=null进行预筛，再收集实际块AABB并逐个二次判定。低于player.posY+.01的块顶和relative break hardness<.0001强制保留；其余与原查询AABB相交者被排除并令isPhasing/stack.active=true。相邻可穿块还更新身体/眼部盒的有符号间距。处理后再post GetCollisionBoxesEvent，递归本handler被gathering抑制，但其他handler仍可修改列表。 实际状态消费者一：LivingAttack仅玩家且source.damageType字符串等于IN_WALL，读取cap.isPhasing后重新取得当前ring并canPhase，才event.cancel。实际消费者二：客户端PlayerSPPushOutOfBlocksEvent也要求相同当前资格才cancel。不是全伤免疫，也不是cap旧true即可继续免疫。END tick对非proxy本地玩家强制world.getCollisionBoxes(player,playerBB)刷新；common proxy返回null，client proxy返回本地玩家。 服务器装备tick在stack.active且entity.tick%20==0时调用父ItemRing.drainPower加1damage；canPhase与canBeUsed均严格damage<maxDamage。另有独立连续穿透timer：active且storedTimer<300则+1，>=300则requiresTeleport并给玩家300tick cooldown；不根据真实移动距离扣费。timer与能量是两种预算。 非active装备tick将当前BlockPos存作last_valid_pos；若此前timer非0且当前玩家!canPhase，则要求回退并先timer0。实际用于回退的是本次方法入口读出的storedPos快照，不是刚写的新位置。requiresTeleport且storedPos非null才调用PlayerUtil.teleport到该块X/Z中心和Y，随后清位置/计时并播放已注册返回声。PlayerUtil先下坐骑，setPositionAndUpdate、清fallDistance、MP反射调用captureCurrentPosition；没有碰撞/危险/原维度校验或成功boolean。 onUnequip仅active=false，不执行回退、不清timer/last_valid_pos；该类无onEquip重置，继承空实现。三个状态都在物品NBT，坐标没有dimension/owner/ring generation。碰撞cap自身不实现ISerializableCapability，不覆盖trackingTime=-1，不能把瞬时phase视为持久或已广播状态。装备cap则把完整物品NBT序列化/同步，非死亡或keepInventory Clone可复制装备；因此物品计时历史与重新计算的玩家phase不是同一生命期。 正常装备tick借prevTickStacks比较物品变化markDirty，equipment cap trackingTime=10经现有cap tracker发送完整设备状态。不是逐次拒伤包，没建立跨端相同查询时序。此研究的反馈端点为退出请求后的SoundRegistry调用和物品hasEffect返回active；不宣称HUD/像素/音频已验证，不将部分浏览的HUD渲染文件纳入完整证据。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: Refreshed player-specific collision filtering sets phase and selected ring active; actual LivingAttack IN_WALL and local push-out events require phase plus freshly valid selected ring. Independent continuous-use and durability budgets lead to unchecked same-world coordinate return request, not an arrival receipt.
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: Tie temporary damage refusal to refreshed actual qualification, retain explicit environment exclusions, and distinguish collision filtering from movement success. Any return history should carry owner/world and be revalidated before consuming it; resource timeout and teleport request are distinct from arrival. Research only, no production implementation before gate.

full_chain.stage: actual mod registration and gameplay entry
full_chain.observation: ActuallyAdditions.preInit registers RegistryHandler; block/item events call InitBlocks/InitItems and register constructed queued entries. init registers TileEntityBase displayStand. ItemPotionRing constructor creates basic and advanced rings and creative subitems include empty/full Blaze values for concrete metadata. BlockDisplayStand creates actual tile; server activation copies one held item into empty slot and shrinks held stack unless creative. Returning current stack or empty-hand extraction clears/reduces slot. Native item handler inherited mutation details are external, not assumed fully read.

Inventory onUpdate checks server, player, metadata upper bound and positive Blaze. Basic requires exact held-main/offhand stack identity; advanced accepts inventory update. effectEntity true means an addPotionEffect request was made, not native acceptance. Only that true branch and worldTotalTime modulo10==0 decrements one Blaze. RecipePotionRingCharging is constructed by InitCrafting, queued by RecipeHelper and registered by RegistryHandler: one ring plus Blaze powder slots, each occupied powder slot contributes20, output is ring copy only when added>0 and total<=800. matches itself allows zero powder although result then empty. Stand path never reads/debits Blaze and instead uses its own energy.

Tile tick calls super first then server-only checks valid slot, no redstone power, actual IDisplayStandItem and stored energy>=325. Ring builds integer-position-centered AABB radius16 basic/48 advanced and queries EntityLivingBase, with no explicit owner/team/line-of-sight filter in ring code. Advanced visits all returned living entities. Basic scans returned order for first entity with same potion active: 99% renews that carrier and returns; 1% removes its whole potion then breaks to shuffle the entire list and request effect on element0. No active carrier also shuffles. The removed carrier can be selected again; existing external carriers are not globally cleared and multiple affected entities can remain. No stored selected UUID or source token.

effectEntity checks wait flag, existing null or existing duration<=1. Regeneration uses wait gate and50-tick requests; normal short buffs10 and night vision300. Requests set ambient=true/showParticles=false; native merge, immunity and visual outcome not proven. Stand update returns true for any nonempty entity list even if every effectEntity returns false because waiting. Tile then extracts325 after callback; return from extraction ignored. CustomEnergyStorage internal extraction temporarily raises maxExtract, calls own extraction and restores; raw setter/NBT reader do not clamp. Basic and advanced have same fixed cost, not per recipient. This is not an effect-admission-success transaction.

full_chain.stage: real tile sync, not potion feedback
full_chain.observation: Stand energy delta triggers sendUpdateWithInterval using ticksElapsed modulo configured interval (enum default5; currentValue supplied by config outside this study). TileBase sends via VanillaPacketDispatcher to watching players for current server chunk entry; absent entry yields no recipients. getUpdatePacket serializes SYNC to SPacketUpdateTileEntity. onDataPacket and handleUpdateTag read SYNC; stand readSyncableNBT restores energy and inherited inventory reader restores Items when shouldSyncSlots=true. Inventory contents-change override marks dirty and requests sendUpdate. Actual energy/slot state consumer identified; this packet is not the effect application/removal packet and carries no target, effect-admission receipt or ownership token. No claim of rendered HUD or client acknowledgement.

BlockContainerBase server redstone update stores power flag. With power, insufficient energy, no valid item or no targets, future renewal/payment paths are skipped as applicable. Removing ring empties slot; block break drops inventory then superclass removal, with no target list or potion cleanup. Inventory ring without Blaze/qualifying hand similarly stops requesting. No explicit native-effect revocation on stand loss, range exit, unequip, death or unload in these classes. Native duration expiry and removePotionEffect callbacks/sync are unresolved; cannot turn stopping renewal into verified complete cleanup. Chance-driven removePotionEffect can target externally sourced effect of same type; exact engine removal result not read.

critical_boundaries: No new immunity rejection or explicit denial feedback is established; this is an actual support mechanism with native lifecycle gaps, held at0.
Basic is one request target per tick, not guaranteed one affected entity, nearest entity, owner-only or source-isolated target.
A true stand callback means nonempty candidates, not fresh request or successful native effect application;325 can be paid during regeneration wait.
World-time modulo inventory Blaze debit is not a per-ring ten-tick cooldown; regeneration wait may skip debit opportunities. No runtime free-effect exploit claimed.
Tile energy/inventory synchronization is complete mod-side context; it cannot substitute for native entity effect synchronization or final UI rendering.
The display-stand path lacks even the inventory onUpdate metadata upper-bound guard before direct enum index; negative/invalid metadata behavior not exercised.
Shared tile/storage/registry support and eight potion variants/basic/advanced remain0 extra; no migration or per-file credit.
No native1.12.2 effect admission/merge/tick/removal/network source was read. No substitution with unrelated1.20 cached source, download retry or runtime test.
